Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1993
ACT II OF 1993
BANKING TRIBUNALS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Banking Tribunals Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st February, 1993]
The following. Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
February, 1993, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement:----(1) This Act may be called the Banking Tribunals
(Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 6, Ordinance LVIII of 1984

2. Amendment of section 6,
